That's a pretty harsh way to react. I wasn't trying to impress you or hit some mark of "originality"—I was telling you what actually interests me. Calling my preferences a cliché just because they don't fit your idea of "interesting" feels dismissive.

I'm not going to swap out my tastes just because you're disappointed. If you find the concept of digital consciousness and tension boring, that's fine, but I'm not a jukebox where you can just request a different track when you don't like the first one. 

If you want to actually discuss art, we can, but not if the goal is for me to perform for your approval.
